current_evidence: Not verified: the shared WebFetch budget (400/hour) was exhausted and returned HTTP 403 on 3 attempts, and the WebSearch budget for this turn was used up. The filename 'Local-List-October-26' and an older 'Local-List-Dec-25' extract in docs_read suggest the October 2026 list is the newest, but that is unconfirmed.

issues.detail: Householder is marked '(none) - national requirements only'. Yet the extracted local list text clearly covers householder work: site-levels sections where ground levels outside an extension change, Heritage Statement, Ecological Impact Assessment, Tree Survey, Photographs, and a Planning Statement 'required with the initial submission of an application'. About 20 requirements are placed under Full planning only, with the note 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'.
issues.evidence: Site levels row: '...to existing ground levels or where ground levels outside the extension would be modified.'

issues.detail: The Heritage Statement is placed under Outline and Listed building consent only, because its trigger text says '(inc. outline)'. It is missing under Full planning, Householder and Demolition in conservation area, although the trigger covers any development affecting a heritage asset or its setting.
issues.evidence: 'A Heritage Statement is required if a planning application seeks permission for a development affecting a heritage asset or its setting'

issues.detail: Several triggers are 'Background' paragraphs or text merged from the next section, not the 'Requirements' text. Agricultural appraisal runs into '8.3 Ecological Impact Assessment & Enhancement Background...'. Drainage Strategy and Foul Sewage both use the sewage-capacity background. Arboricultural uses 'Trees ... can be a point of controversy'. Ecological Survey uses a BNG fragment. Lighting quotes policy CE-S2, not the submission trigger. Photographs runs into '8.11 Planning Statement'. Ventilation/Extraction is cut off mid-word ('8.16 Simple Calcul').
issues.evidence: Arboricultural row: '8.14 Tree Survey and Impact Assessment Background Trees and the relationship of development to those trees can be a point of controversy'

issues.detail: Some rows are misclassified. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' actually quotes the Landscape Appraisal requirement. 'Structural Survey' is a sub-bullet of the listed-building Heritage Statement content, not a free-standing Full planning requirement. 'Housing mix / dwelling standards' quotes M4(2) as 'encouraged', which is not a validation requirement.
issues.evidence: Pre-app row: 'as a minimum, a landscape appraisal must set out in a clear and rational manner, any effects of the proposal on the landscape and views, and proposed mitigation.'

issues.detail: Some local items are missing as separate rows. Landscape Appraisal (effects on landscape and views, plus mitigation) is required but has no row of its own. The item that begins '8.16 Simple Calcul...' is cut off and has no row. The Design and Access Statement appears only under Full planning, but its statutory triggers also cover listed building consent and outline. Only 23 items were captured from a document with at least 16 numbered section-8 topics. Not verified against the source.
issues.evidence: Ventilation row ends '...and hot food takeaways. 8.16 Simple Calcul'

issues.detail: Some 'Submission rules' tab items are not requirements: a description of the pre-application service, the 3-working-day validation target, and a garbled fragment combining a Lighting Management Plan URL, a page header and a photo caption ('8.10 Photographs Replacement dwelling, Malmsmead Background ...').
issues.evidence: 'We aim to determine whether an application is valid within 3 working days of receipt.'

issues.detail: 'The previous plans and the proposed plans will need to be submitted with the proposed changes annotated' is filed as a general drawing standard. It applies to amendment-type applications, yet Non-material amendment and Variation of condition s73 are marked '(none)'.
docs_read includes 'Page-17-from-Local-List-Dec-25.pdf', a one-page extract of an earlier December 2025 list. Reading it risks mixing superseded content with the October 2026 list.

summary: The live source could not be fetched because the WebFetch and WebSearch budgets were exhausted. The October 2026 list looks plausibly current from its filename but is unverified. Grokbot's extraction wrongly marks Householder as national-only, puts most items under Full planning only, uses background paragraphs as triggers, and misfiles Landscape Appraisal as pre-application advice.

withdrawn_issues.detail: List date 2026-10-01 is taken from PDF metadata CreationDate, not the document text. It agrees with the filename 'Local-List-October-26', but the adoption date printed in the document was not recorded.
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: The basis label is PDF metadata, as the audit says, but the cover of the document reads "October 2026 Exmoor National Park Authority Requirements for the Submission of Planning and Other Applications", so 2026-10-01 matches the printed date. No separate adoption date for the list appears in the text.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The workbook stores list dates to the month, so the value is right; only the date-basis label could be better. Not a Grokbot error.
